name: Icon and wordmark settle with a tagline
looks: A simple document icon and the product's wordmark fade and settle together at the centre of a warm, near-white field, with a short one-line tagline appearing beneath in a lighter weight.
build: wordmark-assemble's finished-state settle (icon and letters arriving together rather than letter by letter, since the mark is short) on a soft `power3.out`; the tagline fades in after a short pause.
sound: A single soft confirm tone as the lockup settles.
prompt: Settle on the product's simple icon and name together at the centre of a calm field, with a short one-line tagline beneath it stating exactly what it is, as a clean beat between the hook and the demo.
